verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI-powered invoice entry, approval, and payment automation alongside a Payments API for vendor payments and an Accounting API, which together plausibly support AI reading bills and pre-filling payment details for review. However, this is vendor-only marketing language with no walkthrough of the bill-reading/auto-populate mechanics or independent confirmation it works as described. Missing for 10: concrete documentation/demo of bill/invoice OCR-to-payment-detail extraction, evidence of a human-review step in that specific flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
